test_refs.title: RS-L01 list identities contact status counts and wallet match the API after reload

scenarios.implementation_note: List identity, contact, status, client counts, wallet text and reload match the API. Package-count assertions against a controlled seed remain.

scenarios.description: Filter name/username/phone/network/zone/status independently and combined; assert included/excluded identities, then reset restores baseline.

test_refs.title: RS-L02 name filter includes the selected reseller and reset restores the baseline
RS-L02 phone filter matches the API and excludes a non-matching number
RS-L02 username filter keeps only matching usernames and an unknown username is empty
RS-L02 status filter matches included rows and reload clears it
RS-L02 zone filter matches the API page for the selected zone
RS-L02 network filter matches the API page for the selected network
RS-L02 combined name and status filters agree with the API

scenarios.implementation_note: Name, phone, status, zone, network and combined name+status pass. Username exclusion fails on CP and MK: Reseller Filters.php has no Username filter, so an unknown username keeps the company total (received 1, expected 0).

scenarios.description: Pagination and page-size changes retain scope; filtering from later page resets to valid results without duplicates/stale empty page.

test_refs.title: RS-L03 pagination buttons match the current page bounds

scenarios.implementation_note: Previous/next bounds are checked, including page 2 when it exists. CP and MK have one page. Page size is not changed because it persists staff item_per_page. Later-page filter reset remains.

scenarios.description: Empty/no-match and request failure remain distinguishable and recoverable; optional missing user/wallet/zone does not crash table actions.

test_refs.title: RS-L04 an unmatched name is empty and clearing it restores the list

scenarios.implementation_note: Unmatched name shows No results, the row menu opens, and clearing the name restores the row. Request-failure recovery remains.

scenarios.description: Create with valid identity/network and approved packages; list/reopened edit/detail preserve company, billing, contacts and selected package relationships under returned UUID.
scenarios.implementation_note: Successful create assigns packages and provisions a login. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Missing/short name, missing create credentials, short phone and missing network show approved validation; no reseller/login/staff side effects occur on rejected create.

test_refs.title: RS-F02 missing name credentials phone and network stay on the form and create nothing

scenarios.implementation_note: Empty name, phone and network show required errors. Username and password required errors appear after the other base fields are valid. Short name and phone show the minimum-length errors. List total stays unchanged.

scenarios.description: Duplicate username within company is rejected preserving draft. Company email policy failures display correctly. Cross-company duplicate policy is tested only after approval.

test_refs.title: RS-F03 a duplicate company username is rejected and the draft is not created

scenarios.implementation_note: Duplicate company username is rejected and the list total stays unchanged. Email-policy and cross-company duplicate cases remain.

scenarios.description: Complete queued provisioning, then log in with newly created reseller in a separate context; correct reseller role/profile/permissions/wallet readiness appears without exposing parent-company data.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked provisioning and reseller login. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Open edit directly using UUID; saved fields hydrate before changes. Change contact/date/billing fields; reload persists choices, zero values and unrelated fields without resetting to create defaults.

test_refs.title: RS-F05 edit hydrates the saved reseller and cancel leaves it unchanged

scenarios.implementation_note: Edit hydrates the saved reseller and cancel leaves the detail unchanged. Saved contact/billing edits were not submitted.

scenarios.description: Cancel create/edit produces no new account or persisted changes; server rejection preserves recoverable form and no false success.

test_refs.title: RS-F06 cancel create stores no reseller

scenarios.implementation_note: Cancel on create stores no reseller. Cancel-edit and server-rejection recovery remain.

scenarios.description: Agent selection requires commission; negative/fractional commission rejected by approved policy; unset agent/null commission and count_commission choices persist correctly after reload.

test_refs.title: RS-F07 an agent requires a nonnegative whole-number commission and creates nothing

scenarios.implementation_note: Agent commission is required and negative or fractional values stay on the form. Nothing is created. Persisted unset-agent and count_commission choices remain.

scenarios.description: Billing prepaid/postpaid, auto-recharge, overdue, termination time, serial start and prefix persist within approved boundaries; invalid inputs are rejected server-side without partial account changes.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked billing persistence. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Rapid duplicate submit creates one intended reseller/login/staff set; injected provisioning failure follows approved rollback and leaves no orphan usable account.
scenarios.implementation_note: Duplicate submit needs a disposable create. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Detail opens correct UUID from list, shows profile/status and package assignments; back/edit destinations retain correct reseller identity.

test_refs.title: RS-P01 detail opens the selected reseller and edit returns to that UUID

scenarios.implementation_note: View opens the selected reseller profile and package tab. Edit and back links keep that UUID.

scenarios.description: Assign/remove approved company packages, reload and verify ownership/client visibility changes exactly as approved. No foreign package can be assigned by forged ID.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked package assignment. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Selecting another reseller's assigned package is rejected or transferred only under explicit approved authority, with original reseller/client records reconciled; never silently accept unexpected reassignment.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked package ownership transfer. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Clients tab requires resellers.client and shows only selected reseller's records/counts across pages. Switching reseller detail must not reuse prior client rows; verify duplicate-route resolution first.

test_refs.title: RS-P04 clients tab matches the selected reseller and clears when another reseller opens

scenarios.implementation_note: Client tab names match resellers/client/{uuid}. CP and MK each have one reseller, so the second-reseller switch did not run.

scenarios.description: No-package/no-client detail states remain usable; failed client-tab fetch does not hide successfully loaded profile/package data.

test_refs.title: RS-P05 package and profile tabs stay usable for the open reseller

scenarios.implementation_note: Package tab stays usable and the profile name remains. A failed client-tab fetch was not injected.

scenarios.description: Permission-editor link requires approved combined capabilities and targets correct reseller; updates cannot grant permissions beyond caller's delegated scope. Full editor matrix is a follow-up.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked permission editor. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Open settings loads selected reseller termination setting; toggle saves immediately and reopen/reload confirms persistence without changing sibling/company default settings.

test_refs.title: RS-S01 the reseller termination setting toggles, persists, and restores without changing company scope

scenarios.implementation_note: Termination flag toggles, persists, and is restored. Company and sibling flags stay unchanged.

scenarios.description: Slow save blocks repeated toggles; failure restores last synced value and no success; rapid reseller dialog switching never saves to stale UUID.
scenarios.implementation_note: Stale-UUID and repeated-toggle races were not intercepted. Not executed.

scenarios.description: Without settings authority, action/API read/write is denied. Forged foreign reseller_uuid cannot expose or overwrite another company's settings.

test_refs.title: RS-S03 a foreign reseller UUID cannot be read or written as settings

scenarios.implementation_note: Foreign reseller UUID settings read and write are denied and the owner flag stays unchanged. A permission-less persona remains.

scenarios.description: Upload/replace/remove avatar and each NID image on saved reseller; reload confirms only intended field changes. Standard form payload excludes private image fields.
scenarios.implementation_note: Review-blocked image upload. Not executed.

test_refs.title: RS-W02 a nonpositive amount and missing fund stay in the dialog and keep the balance
